buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Technical Qualification and Minimum Performance Requirements : The Bidder must have following technical experience with minimum order values as below:- Bidders should have successfully completed similar works to any Transmission Li censee or Generation plant during last 5 Years as on the originally scheduled date of tender opening i.e. 30.11.2026 Applicant must submit details in support of above as per Table A-1 along with nece ssary documents. 3.0 Financial Qualification 3.3.1 The Minimum Average Annual Turnover* (MAAT) will be taken as Average of the Best Three Financial Years Turnover out of the Last Five financial years preceding to the year of NIT is published. In case the Applicant is in existence for less than five financial years the minimum average annual turnover shall be average of the turnover of the completed no. of financial years. The Applic ant who is in existence for less than one complete financial year shall not be qualified. The MAAT shall not be less than 5 Lakh. The project related turnover of the tendering company on standalone basis only (excluding its Associate c ompanies /Holding Company) shall be considered. 3.3.2 The Applicant shall have Liquid Assets (Cash at Bank & Fixed Deposit) an d Un-Utilised credit facility (both Fund &Non Fund based) available from bank (s) duly certified by the Bank(s) at the end of Month preceding to the previous Month of Tender opening, shall not be less than 0.3 Lakh. .3.3 Net worth of Applicant as per the audited financial results shall be po sitive on the last day of the preceding financial year. Net Worth means the s um total of the paid-up share capital and free reserves (excluding reserves cr

eated out of the revaluation of assets, write back of depreciation provisions a nd amalgamation & Capital Reserve) net of P&LA/C (Dr. balance) and miscella neous expenses to the extent not adjusted or written off. 3.3.4 The Applicant shall furnish documentary evidence (Audited Annual Account & C A Certificate). CA Certificate without UDIN No. will not be considered in supp ort of the qualifying requirement stipulated as above: Note: LA &Net Worth not required at Division Level procurement. Sl. No. Financial Qualifications (Rs. in Lakh.) 1 MAAT 5 Lakh 2 LA 0.3 Lakh 3 Net Worth Positive 3.3.5 The Owner reserves the right to reject the proposal of the Applicant, if: (a) The Applicant made misleading or false representation in the form of statem ents and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements. (b) Has a record of poor performance such as abandoning the works, not proper ly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion. 3.4 Registration of ESI, EPF, WC Policy, Labor License and Electrical Saf ety Registration:- a) The Applicant must be registered in ESI & EPF respectively including Labor d epartment Registration in UP Govt. ( b ) *The Applicant must be registered as Class A contractor in Electrical Safety Department of UP or any other State Govt. or Centr al Govt. (which shall be verified) and shall get extended during the ten ure of Agreement. (c) The Bidder must submit Character Certificate issued by District Magistrate ( DM) valid on the date of Bid Submission. Copies of Certificates in this respect shall be submitted along with Tender docu ments. (d) The Applicant should also have W.C. Policy or give affidavit to take the same before Start of the respective Work allotted to the Firm as per terms of the Co ntract awarded. (e) Valid Registration in GST. (f) Financial- Latest 3 financial year income tax return, PAN Card, P&L and B ala nce Sheet (if applicable as per income tax act 1961) . (g) After Gem contract, Contract Must also be done on E stamp paper . 3.5 Applicants Credibility Criteria: (i) The Applicant who stands currently debarred by UPPTCL / Any DISCOM of UP / Govt. of UP or black listed by any Distribution/ Transmission/ Generation Utility/Govt. Department in India as on the schedule date of opening of tende r shall not be eligible to participate in this tender. (ii) The Applicants should not have any pending litigation with UPPTCL with rega rd to any O&M Work/Project or related activity. ANNEXUREs against Technical PQR Table A-1 (Work Order Details)
